## Purpose
Scrape Oxford, OH listings from ApartmentList. The listings are stored as JSON inside the page. ApartmentList only had a few Oxford listings, which is why we added Zumper and Rentler.

## Check permission
```{r robots}
robotstxt::paths_allowed(paths = "/oh/oxford", domain = "apartmentlist.com")
```

## Scraping function
```{r function}
get_listings = function(url) {
  pg = rvest::read_html(url)
  pg |>
    rvest::html_elements("script[type='application/ld+json']") |>
    rvest::html_text2() |>
    purrr::keep(\(x) stringr::str_detect(x, "\"@type\":\"Product\"")) |>
    purrr::map_df(\(x) jsonlite::fromJSON(x, flatten = TRUE)) -> df
  Sys.sleep(1)
  return(df)
}
```

## Find every page and scrape
```{r scrape}
base = "https://www.apartmentlist.com/oh/oxford"
page_links = rvest::read_html(base) |>
  rvest::html_elements("a[href*='/oh/oxford/page-']") |>
  rvest::html_attr("href") |>
  unique()
oxford_urls = c(base, if (length(page_links) > 0) paste0("https://www.apartmentlist.com", page_links))

listings_raw = purrr::map_df(.x = oxford_urls, .f = get_listings) |>
  dplyr::mutate(scrape_date = Sys.Date())
readr::write_csv(listings_raw, "data/apartmentlist_oxford_raw.csv")

listings_raw |>
  dplyr::filter(stringr::str_detect(url, "/oh/oxford/")) |>
  dplyr::distinct(url, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::select(name, url, offers.lowPrice, offers.highPrice)
```
